question.text: Under the SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015, a 'connected person' includes a person who has been associated with a company during what period prior to the concerned act?

explanation.text: The Logic: A 'connected person' includes any person who is, or who has during the six months prior to the concerned act been, associated with a company directly or indirectly in any capacity. The Trap: Other regulations use different look-back periods (three months, twelve months, twenty-four months) for various purposes; the insider-trading connected-person definition specifically uses six months. Note: The six-month window is intended to capture recent associations that could plausibly have provided access to unpublished price-sensitive information.
